description:
Yun Si-Ho has one goal: to survive university without becoming one half of the school’s first official gay couple. But his best friend and classmate, Ji Seung-Hyeon, is making that impossible with his relentless, daily advances. Just as Si-Ho hits his breaking point, a mysterious app appears on his phone, claiming to show the "affection levels" of handsome men. Si-Ho sees his chance. He’ll use the app to systematically lower Seung-Hyeon’s feelings and finally get his peace! There’s just one problem: no matter what Si-Ho does, Seung-Hyeon’s meter keeps rising... and it’s not just his affection that’s standing tall.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Miyeonsi Danpyeonseon (미연시 단편선) Collection.*
